status: fixed before any policy replay on these traces. Before fixing it, only pre-test data were inspected to choose demand signals and capacity units: Huawei relative days 0-7 (requests, pods, CPU) and Azure day 1 durations plus days 0-7 invocation means. No test-period policy outcome had been computed for Paper 1 on these traces. The companion Paper 2 had analysed the same traces with a different question (h=2 forecasts, day-scale windows); its results are not used here.
question: Do the Alibaba findings (strict-budget rank effect, conformal-plus-offset vs pre-test-selected reactive, resource-overload comparison) replicate on two further trace families from other providers?

huawei2023.source: Huawei Cloud private dataset 2023 (Joosen et al., SoCC 2023), shared-data/huawei_2023/private/{requests,instances,cpu_usage}_minute/day_XXX.csv
huawei2023.period: longest contiguous run of days, 28-60 (33 days); relative day r = day - 28
huawei2023.selection: relative days 0-7 only: requests present in >=99% of minutes, mean >=1 request/min, pods (instances>=1) recorded in >=99% of minutes; all eligible functions are used
huawei2023.demand: requests per minute; empty request cells are 0 (the trace has no explicit zeros)
huawei2023.capacity_unit: mu_s = median over relative days 0-7 of requests per pod per minute (minutes with >=1 pod); one unit = the median per-pod throughput observed before the test
huawei2023.mu_sensitivity: mu_s from the 90th percentile of the same pre-test per-pod throughput
huawei2023.observed_capacity: recorded pods (missing -> 0), reported as a secondary denominator only

azure2019.source: Azure Functions 2019 (Shahrad et al., USENIX ATC 2020), invocations_per_function_md.anon.dNN.csv
azure2019.unit: application (sum of its functions; the unit Azure Functions scales)
azure2019.period: 14 days; relative day r = file index - 1
azure2019.selection: present in all 14 day files, mean >=1 invocation/min and >=50% non-zero minutes on days 0-7; all eligible applications are used; dominant trigger by invocation volume defines the descriptive group (http, timer, queue, other)
azure2019.capacity_unit: the trace has no capacity metadata; mu_s = (mean invocations/min on days 0-7) / 10, i.e. the pre-test mean load corresponds to 10 capacity units. This is a surrogate granularity, not a physical calibration
azure2019.mu_sensitivity: K = 5 and K = 20 units at the pre-test mean

families.alibaba_regression: the same generic replay code is run on the verified Alibaba 200 series (mu=1, observed-capacity denominator) and must reproduce the stored rank-ablation, reactive-grid, and strict-budget rows exactly (atol 1e-12)

warm_start: the last W positive persistence residuals of the pre-test period

policies.B4: Gaussian mean + z_(1-delta) std of signed residuals
policies.B1: reactive: desired = max(1, ceil(previous demand / (u * mu_s))), thresholds {0.50,0.60,0.70,0.80,0.85,0.90,0.95,0.99} x cooldowns {1,3,5,10}; initial capacity = max(1, ceil(last pre-period demand / (0.8 mu_s))); per-service selection on calibration days as in the paper (lowest calibration relative cost with calibration overload <= delta; else lowest overload)
policies.grids_for_resource_axis: conformal alpha {1,1.25,1.5,2} at rank levels {0.01,0.05} with/without offset; Gaussian z {1.28,1.64,z_0.95,1.96,z_0.99,3,4} with/without offset; the 32 reactive configurations (fleet-uniform)

metrics.compliance: fraction of units with realised test overload fraction <= delta
metrics.mean_overload: mean over units of realised test overload fraction
metrics.relative_cost: C_replay(policy) / C_replay(clairvoyant), clairvoyant capacity max(1, ceil(d_t/mu_s)) with zero overload; the same denominator for all policies of a unit
metrics.secondary: Huawei: C_res relative to recorded pods; floor fraction; guard activation
metrics.strata: Huawei: halves by pre-test mean demand in units; Azure: dominant trigger group

inference: exact paired compliance counts (conformal-only vs comparator-only compliant units) with two-sided binomial p-values, reported as unadjusted descriptive statistics; no new confirmatory claim
reporting: all results are reported whatever their direction; no grid extension or selection after seeing test outcomes
scope: trace replay with immediate actuation; no latency, no live cluster
